skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concept, role, and functions of an office and office management in a business environment.
Understand the organizational structure of an office, including modernization trends.
Understand the classification, roles, and standards of office staff, and develop recruitment and training strategies.
Master basic office tasks such as organizing meetings, managing time, and handling guest reception.
Understand document classification, management processes, and security measures.
Master the techniques of drafting administrative documents.
